name: MSK-IMPACT 50K Clinical Sequencing Cohort (MSK, Cancer Cell 2026)
description: MSK-50K (Memorial Sloan Kettering - 50,000 patients) is a pan-cancer clinical sequencing cohort of 54,331 tumors and their matched normal samples, profiled using MSK-IMPACT. The dataset includes somatic mutations, gene-level copy number alterations, structural variants in select genes, genome-wide allele-specific copy number, cancer cell fractions of mutations, derived mutational signatures, whole genome doubling status, and somatic/germline HLA Class I Genotype data. This data is available under the Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 4.0 license. For commercial use, please contact datarequests@mskcc.org.
